about: Music and sound effects generated on RUN.world (scripts/runworld-audio.mjs), from the list in docs/NARRATION_SCRIPT.md (owner 2026-10-10: "have the run.world cli do the narrations at some point and some music/effects"). Files land in apps/web/public/audio/<id>.mp3 beside index.html, like vo/; the owner auditions them on the dev audio page before they are committed. Effects are at least 0.5 s (the service minimum; the game trims short ones). Loops are generated long enough to loop and cut to a seamless loop at integration. The Moon's score gains fidelity with the stages: one track per stage, same key and tempo, crossfaded as a plot rises (S0 static, S1 PC-speaker, S2 EGA-era chiptune, S3 OPL FM synth, S4 sampled late-90s, S5 modern pads, S6 the full open score).

music.prompt: Instrumental ambient score for a quiet shielded science lab at night while a storm rages outside: warm analog synth pads, a low sub drone, sparse glassy piano notes, faint tape hiss, slow, tense but hopeful, D minor, no drums, no vocals, seamless loop

Near silence for a broken low-resolution moon: a thin crackling static wash, a very low sine drone, occasional broken digital artefacts, desolate, D minor, no melody, no drums, no vocals, seamless loop
Desolate moon ambience in D minor: a thin static wash and low drone with a single 1-bit PC-speaker square-wave beep melody every few seconds, very sparse, lonely, no drums, no vocals, seamless loop
Slow sparse 1980s PC chiptune in D minor at 70 BPM: a simple square-wave arpeggio and a soft square-wave bass over a faint drone, lonely but curious, no drums, no vocals, seamless loop
Early 1990s FM synth sound card ambience (OPL3 style) in D minor at 70 BPM: soft FM pads, a gentle FM bass pulse and a slow bell melody, calm and hopeful, light drums, no vocals, seamless loop
Late 1990s sampled game score in D minor at 70 BPM: soft sampled strings, a warm electric piano, a gentle bass and light percussion, hopeful exploration, no vocals, seamless loop
Modern ambient exploration score in D minor at 70 BPM: warm wide synth pads, soft drums, a hopeful piano and string melody building gently, no vocals, seamless loop
Full open cinematic ambient score at 70 BPM resolving from D minor to D major: strings, piano, warm pads and soft percussion, the sky clearing, triumphant but calm, no vocals, seamless loop
Retro 1990s shareware PC game combat music, Sound Blaster FM synth (OPL), driving drums at 140 BPM, menacing distorted FM bass and lead riffs, E minor, no vocals, seamless loop
Steady low-tempo synth pulse for driving a rover across the moon at 90 BPM: an analog bass arpeggio, soft pads and a light electronic beat, focused and calm, D minor, no vocals, seamless loop
